judged_text: usernames input field is not cleared after successfully adding members, causing stale usernames to be resent on subsequent submissions

record.issue_text: usernames input field is not cleared after successfully adding members, causing stale usernames to be resent on subsequent submissions

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `addMembers` action calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` and does not reset/clear the `usernames` property afterward. The template binds the `user-selector` component to `usernames=usernames`, so unless the component clears it internally (not shown in this diff), the entered usernames will remain in the controller state. The code even includes a `// TODO: should clear the input` comment, corroborating that the input is currently not cleared. This can lead to the same usernames being submitted again on a subsequent click.
